title: Why Spartan Women Were Feared
hook: While Athenian women were locked indoors, Spartan women owned 40% of the land and wrestled in public.

scenes.text: In classical Athens, women had zero legal rights, could not own property, and spent their entire lives secluded in the women's quarters.

scenes.voicedText: In classical Athens, women had zero legal rights, could not own property, and spent their entire lives secluded in the women's quarters.

scenes.text: Just one hundred miles away in Sparta, women lived an entirely different existence that shocked and horrified the rest of Greece.

scenes.voicedText: Just one hundred miles away in Sparta, women lived an entirely different existence that shocked and horrified the rest of Greece.

scenes.text: Spartan girls received formal athletic training: running, javelin throwing, and wrestling alongside boys so they would bear strong children.

scenes.text: Because Spartan men spent their lives in barracks or at war, women managed all estates, finances, and agricultural production.

scenes.voicedText: Because Spartan men spent their lives in barracks or at war, women managed all estates, finances, and agricultural production.

scenes.text: By the Hellenistic era, Spartan women owned over forty percent of all land and wealth in the city-state through inheritance.
